description: An ADSR envelope with a VCA built in, so the envelope both comes out on its own jack and multiplies whatever is patched into In

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to rise, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall from its peak to the sustain level, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds while the gate is high, 0 to 100 per cent of the peak
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall to zero once the gate goes low, 1ms to 10 seconds
Scales the whole envelope, 0 to 2; at 1 the Env jack reaches 10V

inputs.text: The signal the envelope multiplies, one per channel; the channel count here is what the Out jack carries
Holds the envelope open while it is at or above 1V, one gate per channel; the channel count here is what the Env jack carries
A trigger here starts the attack again without the gate having gone low
Scales the envelope by voltage, multiplying the Gain knob by a tenth of the voltage here, one channel per output channel

outputs.text: The signal from In multiplied by the envelope
The envelope on its own, reaching 10V at a gain of 1

notes: the Env jack takes its channel count from Gate, so with nothing patched into Gate it carries no channels at all
the envelope rises towards 1.2 times its peak and the attack ends when it reaches the peak, which is what gives the rise its curve

inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Gain knob alone.
